verdict.rationale: Formant's own materials say users can "ask your fleet what's happening in plain language" and get ML-driven task recommendations that people then approve. The analytics docs also mention an AI assistant for building dashboards. This shows natural-language querying and assisted dashboard creation, but not broad operation of the product (sending commands, configuring devices, teleop) through natural language, and the main claim comes from marketing pages. Missing for 10: documented natural-language command execution across core functions (commands, configuration, teleop), in-depth docs on the assistant's scope, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
